findings.title: Required publication gate omits the admin revocation regression check
findings.description: The required pre-push validator claims its contract tests are the complete gate, but it only executes files ending in .test.mjs under scripts/tests. scripts/verify-admin-active-gate.mjs is neither invoked directly nor located there, and no other caller exists. Consequently insecure active-admin guidance can be published. A concrete current example exists in bounded-backend/docs/functions.md: the policy declares admins with an active field at lines 92-99, but the stripeCustomer read rule at line 85 authorizes get(/admins/@user.id) != null. A deactivated former admin therefore retains access to customer-to-user mappings. The standalone regression script would detect this, but the documented publication gate does not run it.
findings.recommendation: Make the admin active-gate check part of the mandatory validation path, preferably as a contract test under scripts/tests, and fail validation on any error. Correct the existing stripeCustomer rule to require get(/admins/@user.id).active == true.
